text: I stand at the threshold between anticipation and curiosity. The warm and open 'Welcome' exudes an inviting atmosphere, yet the sterile glass and ordered chairs remind me of the structures that shape human encounters. Now, inside the vibrant space where knowledge is on display, I feel the pulse of innovation and reflection. Here, learning appears as both spectacle and practice—a living dialogue between past effort and future possibility. I feel eager to engage and ponder my place amid this exchange of ideas.
